decision: Prepare a separately registered, small completion-evidence-filtered task-choice BC feasibility experiment.
basis: The registered label-coverage gate is met and the fixed 20-example independent check matched, but the sample covers only one development game and has no DIG. Among 6809 observed effects, 5517 are WATER; 2000 episode outcomes remain unknown.
required_before_execution: Verify the actor feature and candidate construction has no later state, other player's private information, labels, or outcome-dependent features.
Choose unused seeds with a reproducible search of previous registrations and freeze the complete seed grouping and opponent-seat panel before consuming new data.
Freeze source, one training run, candidate-aware baseline, class-wise exploratory metrics, budget, stopping rule and independent review before opening newly generated test data.
Count uncertain outcomes separately; never mark unknown as negative or describe a selective sample as representative of all tasks.
scope: Only decide implementation details after inspecting the existing task-choice training and trace pipeline; the advice is a proposal, not an executed experiment or claim of improvement.
limits: Offline scores alone cannot establish game strength, causal benefit, reliable population generalization, or model promotion. Default Bot and previously frozen models remain unchanged. No PPO or large-scale training.
